title: Cosmic Eye Desert
description: A surreal desert landscape features a massive cosmic eye with a black pupil and swirling orange, purple and blue nebula in the sky. In the foreground on a rocky cliff edge sit three ornate pottery vases emitting smoke, alongside a large grey spherical robot character with big shiny eyes.
prompt: Surreal desert cliff scene with a giant cosmic eye dominating the sky, its iris made of swirling orange and purple nebula surrounding a black pupil. Floating teal planets orbit the eye. In the foreground, three ornate pottery vases in purple and orange tones emit mystical smoke. A large cute spherical grey robot with big glossy eyes stands on the cliff edge. Dramatic colorful nebula clouds and distant mesas, in a vibrant fantasy style.
